title: HAL tests: Add duty cycle ring buffer overflow test
description: lichen_duty_cycle_record_tx returns false when the 32-entry ring buffer is full. No test verifies this behavior. Add a test that records 33 transmissions and verifies: (1) 33rd returns false, (2) prior state remains consistent, (3) after time advances past window, buffer slots are freed and new records succeed.
close_reason: Added test_duty_cycle_ring_buffer_overflow test: fills 32-entry buffer, verifies 33rd record returns false, checks prior state consistency (32*100ms=3200ms used), verifies slots freed after time advances past 1-hour window
